options.name: Each hero creates a Quicken token.

_comment:
'At the start of your turn, choose 1; - Each hero creates a Quicken token. - Each hero draws a card. - Each hero gains 1{h}.' Bard Weapon - Lute (2H) (Promos, FAB094).

TRIGGER REACHES THE WEAPON: engine._dsl_start_of_turn_listener (engine.py:1461-1466, read this session) dispatches START_OF_TURN to the ACTIVE player's _dsl_permanent_zones, which explicitly includes player.weapon1/weapon2 (engine.py:1452-1459) - a two-handed lute sits there, so the ability fires on its controller's turn only and 'your turn' needs no IS_ACTIVE_PLAYER gate. STATIC_TRIGGERED per its doc ('always watching; fires each time the condition is met'); the interpreter runs it identically to TRIGGERED.

CHOOSE reads amount + options (effect_types.py:5107-5136); options may be named blocks {name, effects} - the labels are what the player picks between at resolution time. One chosen option's effects run in order.

'EACH HERO' is the documented two-effect shape (DSL_REFERENCE Draw/Discard: 'each hero draws a card = a SELF draw + an OPPONENT draw'), ordered SELF first then OPPONENT for all three options:
- CREATE_TOKEN reads token/count|amount/player (effect_types.py:1942-1957); player OPPONENT resolves to the opposing hero (handler maps OPPONENT/DEFENDING/DEFENDER/TARGET_HERO to 3-cid). 'quicken' is the real token slug - json/tokens/quicken.json exists, so no token definition is authored here.
- DRAW reads amount/player (effect_types.py:1222-1249), resolved via _effect_player_id which maps OPPONENT relative to the controller (effect_types.py:826-827).
- GAIN reads asset/amount/player (effect_types.py:4869-4896); LIFE_POINTS is the CR 1.13.1 spelling for {h}.

NO ATTACK AUTHORED: the printed text has no attack clause and the DB entry has power null with no activation cost, so play._add_weapon_attacks offers nothing - correct for this lute, whose entire text is the start-of-turn ability. printed_keywords is empty.
